column7: When making a mechanism seat- or client-aware: fix what decides WED_AGENT in the same action (key on the checkout folder before any hostname; refuse rather than guess), then grep siblings for the literal just replaced. A machine move invalidates hostname maps.

When writing any weekday beside a date (expiry, due date, ticket, mail): derive one from the other with date -j -f %Y-%m-%d <date> +%A. Never infer from a nearby date. A wrong date in a headline is in every digest: fix and regenerate both.

When deciding how many agents to launch, any project: launch every disjoint lane (directory partition, own worktree, partition named from both sides, new seat announced to live seats). Limits: shared code and machine load, not the allowance; QA gate stands.

Before launching a seat, gate or drafter: read my seat's weekly gauge in the same action and put it in the receipt. The 90% no-new-launch cut is a guide since 2026-10-22, not a stop (a seat's own usage row may differ). High gauge: cheap closes first.

Before an Ornith run: unload other models, check memory. Night-only was widened to all hours (09-18); the runner still refuses on live panes not in night/ALLOW_SEATS. Output is checked, source-read, never pushed; a PASS reaches a PR only via a gated seat.

When a board pass proves at SOURCE (not titles) that ticket B is the same defect or ask as A: mark B Duplicate of A, close, archive, one facts-only comment, no outside review. Not if a client human wrote B (theirs to close). Move unique content to A first.

When reading a wrap mail: score and pane_close.sh in the same action. Before any 'no other agents' deadline, list the panes (tmux list-panes -t fleet:0) 10 minutes before and at the minute, close wrapped ones; never rely on a wake arriving.

When Ornith's queue is empty: widen before stopping (extend the checker, or write the next brief within the hour); queue is the whole Backlog/Todo, easy to hard, auth last. Empty is acceptable only with a measured why-line in night/queue.md (Kam, 09-25).

When the next candidates look blocked, decision-shaped or big: judge each ticket after reading it, never a whole tier. Card the blocked one with a default, start the default where reversible, say which were skipped, take the next; 'exhausted' needs a count.

Local model is permanent and the first routing stop; Claude takes the rest. A failed local ticket gets the original brief plus ONE rebrief, then goes to a Claude seat when it makes sense (batched, not a seat per ticket). Name the routing reason in the brief.

-> 2026-10-18_new-account-tickets-backlog-routing-definition-spark-max.md: account-tied grant (Claude seats raise, gate, GO with head SHA and merge TESTED Secuura work, kintsugi only); that account ended at the 10-07 switch.

When two seats on one framework behave differently: enumerate what is NOT in git first (gitignored config, machine daemons, habits). Behaviour-shaping config goes in a tracked template plus renderer; a guard missing is a doctor FAIL; a skip prints its cost.

Before cockpit.sh rotate: ask whether the seat already sent its wrap mail. If yes, do not rotate (a second ritual double-posts): verify the wrap on disk (handover, history), close the pane with pane_close.sh, confirm the old process is gone, then launch.

At boot: sum the bytes of every mandated whole-read (divide by 4 for tokens) and read ctx% before and after the first big read. Read whole if it fits; else bound by structure (live head, headline index, newest rows), say what was bounded, note the numbers.
-> 2026-09-18_the-boot-spec-outgrew-the-context-window.md: measure the files and the window before the boot read; trim only against a measured ceiling and say what was dropped.

When Kam answers a card with a note, not an option: the note is the ruling; record it verbatim, state my reading. A lifted hold lifts that ONE ticket's build and gate (KS-1175); deploying it, anchoring a real record and KS-1250's live smoke run stay Kam's.

When a handover or wrap says prepared, staged, ready or queued: name the durable in-project path or do not use the word. Scratchpad or unpushed worktree work is lost: say it is re-derivable, not prepared.

When Kam hands me a defect: it is mine to fix unless he says otherwise (claim it, fix, test, report). If I need a sister seat, mail her directly through send_brief.sh and tell Kam it is done; do not hand Kam a message to relay.

When making a card for Kam: decision_queue.sh add the moment the decision exists (one decision, options, default), on my own seat's tab; rule it when he answers. HTTP 201 proves storage only: if he cannot see a card, ask for the board footer line first.

-> 2026-09-13_as-many-agents-as-possible-partitioned-by-code.md: Secuura restatement of launch-every-disjoint-lane; its Spark half is dead; signature classes and the QA gate before merge are unchanged.
